reason: Correct two overstatements identified during inspection of the saved live Validator 7 answer; preserve factual admission and raw responses.

decisions.reason: Joining HCA in 1996 does not establish finance-role tenure since 1996. Disclosed finance history starts in July 2004; an internal transition does not establish lower integration risk or financial benefit.
decisions.reviewed_text: Marks became CFO in May 2024 after disclosed internal finance roles dating to July 2004. This supports neutral internal-transition context; execution in the CFO role and any financial benefit remain unestablished.
limitations: The 1996 company-joining date is not a finance-role start date.

decisions.reason: Roster and current appointments alone do not establish cumulative career experience. Accepted operating, finance, human-resources and clinical role histories support a narrower continuity inference, not demonstrated stability or performance.
decisions.reviewed_text: Several accepted internal career histories may support continuity of company knowledge, a limited credit-positive consideration. Those histories do not establish management competence, operating performance or protection from cost, labor and regulatory pressures.
limitations: Career-history references replace the insufficient roster/appointment-only basis.

overall.text: The surviving management evidence supports a limited continuity positive from Hazen's disclosed internal experience and several accepted team career histories. Marks' May 2024 CFO appointment follows disclosed finance roles dating to July 2004; it supports neutral transition monitoring, not finance tenure since his 1996 company joining. McAlevey's expanded remit also warrants neutral transition monitoring. These histories do not demonstrate competence, execution outcomes or a measurable financial benefit. Labor, regulatory and debt-service risks remain relevant; two inaccurate citation claims remain excluded.
limitations: Continuity is a bounded analytical inference; competence and realized credit effects are unestablished.
Performance, incentive alignment and future execution remain unverified.
Two inaccurate citation claims are excluded without discarding independently supported findings.
